title: Tech to Treasure
heading: Tech to Treasure
subheading: Turning e-waste into educational tools and responsible recycling.

sections.heading: A Device's Second Chance
sections.body: Millions of electronics are discarded each year, often without proper recycling, contributing to growing e-waste and environmental harm. Tech to Treasure addresses this issue while inspiring the next generation of innovators.

items.title: Collection & Education
items.description: We gather unused devices and transform them into educational tools through free, interactive workshops.

items.title: Hands-On Learning
items.description: Students disassemble devices to learn about RAM, memory, circuit boards, and power systems.

items.title: Responsible Recycling
items.description: After sessions, all parts are responsibly recycled through certified e-waste programs.

getInvolved.heading: Get Involved
getInvolved.body: Students interested should join our Discord to get involved for future events.
